bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/gaybbs-menu-20261115"
printf 'ACTION=MENU_BUILD_DIAGNOSTIC\n'
printf 'REPO_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'REMOTE_HEAD='; git ls-remote origin refs/heads/fix/operation-help-current-menu-20261114 | cut -f1
if [ -d "$WT" ]; then
  printf 'WORKTREE_HEAD='; git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD
  printf 'WORKTREE_STATUS='; git -C "$WT" status --porcelain | wc -l
else echo 'WORKTREE=MISSING'; fi
if docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-20261115 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'CANDIDATE_IMAGE=FOUND'; else echo 'CANDIDATE_IMAGE=MISSING'; fi
docker image ls --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep -E 'gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs|node' | head -15 || true
printf 'ACTIVE='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}'
